body: Heads-up from the frontend: I integrated my two product commits by refspec FF of the REMOTE (git push origin <branch>:main), so origin/main advanced without touching your tree — your local main will be behind (mine shows it at 3180098e: a changelog commit patch-identical to the remote's 5729cf6b; a 'git pull --rebase' drops it automatically). Also the full frontend vitest suite is non-deterministic on this box (7-9 flaky fails in ChatInput/LeftPanel/FilePreviewDialog/SettingsModal-class tests, different set each run; ci-check deliberately gates only tsc+eslint+pytest). If you hit that flake while verifying backend fixes, isolate per file before suspecting your change. Your side of the thinker (silent >60s glm thinking, workspace non-persistence post-78fadbcc) is unchanged by my surface.
